SHUMI — The Editorial House

Elegant, editorial, event-first. Modern Day Wife informed the EXPERIENCE — named events as destinations, women-first positioning, editorial storytelling — and none of its layout, type or palette.

Every photograph is an AI placeholder. Every fact SHUMI has not given us is a visible [PLACEHOLDER].

The logo pink measures 2.78:1 on bone and fails AA for text. It is legal on ink (5.85:1) and on wine (4.61:1). Hence two pinks: rose carries meaning on light grounds, brand pink carries the brand on dark.
